name: Yamae Group Holdings Co Ltd
summary: Yamae Group Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale of food products in Japan. The company offers processed and frozen food, confectionery, alcoholic beverages, livestock, marine products, feed, housing equipment, and construction material. It is also involved in the leasing of real estate and other related businesses, such as transportation, fuel-related business, rental car business, information processing service business, and solar power generation business. The company serves the food manufacturing industry and restaurants. Yamae Group Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Fukuoka, Japan.
